book.magicka.guide:
# Casting
• G — enable magic.
• 1–4 and Q, E, R, F — add an element. Up to five, repeats allowed.
• Left click casts Primary, right click casts Self.
• V — clear the formula.
A spell is an exact sequence: the elements, how many of each and their order all matter. The order is shown above the description; for ultimates it is a whole ritual. A set with no name casts a fusion — see the Magic section.
# Modes
• Instant cast (⚡ on the panel) is on by default: most spells fire at once, walls and spikes rise whole. Switch it off in the mod settings.
• Streams — sprays, beams, four-element lightning — run while the left button is held (≈).
• Bridges, stairs and growths finish on their own.
• K — the 5×5×5 shape editor for Stone Sculpture.
Earth and roots are permanent; ice and arcane fade. A committed cast cannot be cancelled.
# The book
• It holds the spells you know. The strongest are sealed until you read their scroll, found in chests or dropped by enemies. Scrolls are never used up; in creative everything is open.
• Search understands words, page numbers and tags: #damage, #healing, #building, #destruction, #summon, #support.
• Elements on the right and tags on the left keep matching spells; ◀ ▶ step through the matches.
• Shift — full description.
# Quick slots
• Drag a spell into a slot on the left, or select it and click a slot. Right-click clears a slot.
• Alt+1–4 types the formula for you over a second, then cast with left or right click.
• Manual input or V interrupts it. Keys are configurable.
# Tips
• Fire, cold and lightning hurt you even on Self.
• Wet targets freeze faster and take more from lightning.
• Push into roots to climb them; sneak to slide down slowly.
• Ice Spike follows your view, Stone Stair starts at your feet, Skybridge at your aim.
• Long-range aim works in loaded chunks.
# Death and undead
• Death withers and drains life; two or more summon undead for a while.
• Servants never attack their master, but arrows and blasts hit everyone, and your spells hurt servants too.
• Raise Dead lifts recently fallen creatures. Soul Return and Resurrection (Life + Death) bring back players.
# Support
• Wisp Light (Life + Arcane×2) — a light where it lands.
• Lantern Trail (Fire + Life + Arcane) — lights up to the aim point.
• Glowstone (Fire + Earth + Life) — a glowing block.
• Cat's Eye, Gills, Fire Ward, Miner's Vigor, Revealing Flash, Douse — night vision, water breathing, fire resistance, haste, revealed enemies, fire put out.
Lights and glowstone stay forever.
book.magicka.magic:
# Fusions
Any set of 1–5 elements casts something. If the elements and their order match a named spell, that spell is cast and the elements panel shows its name. Otherwise you cast a fusion: a spell assembled by the rules below. A fusion has no name, so the panel line stays empty.
# Form
The lead element sets it — the most repeated one (ties go Earth, Lightning, Arcane, Death, Life, Cold, Water, Fire):
• Earth — a heavy projectile that bursts from three elements up;
• Cold with Water — a fan of ice shards;
• Arcane, Death, Life — a beam;
• Lightning — a bolt that chains;
• Fire, Water, Cold — a spray.
More elements mean a wider hit, a longer effect and a longer cast.
# Elements
Each adds its own mechanic, and three of a kind reach a peak:
• Fire — damage and burning; ×3 sets the ground alight.
• Water — wet and a push, puts out fire; ×3 — a wave.
• Cold — chill builds up into a freeze; ×3 — an instant freeze.
• Lightning — damage, charge and a chain, each Lightning adds jumps; ×3 — a discharge through the whole crowd.
• Earth — damage, knockback, breaks blocks, stuns from two; ×3 — a quake.
• Life — heals allies, burns the undead, grows grass; ×3 — regeneration too.
• Arcane — damage and Unstable; ×3 — the mark explodes after 2 s.
• Death — drains life and withers; ×3 — executes a foe below 20% health.
# Pair reactions
• Fire + Water — blinding steam.
• Water + Cold — instant ice.
• Water + Lightning — conductivity, the chain is twice as long.
• Fire + Earth — burning ground.
• Cold + Earth — shatter: frozen foes take an extra blow.
• Fire + Lightning — plasma, the chain ignites.
• Lightning + Earth — grounding stuns.
• Arcane + any — catalysis, radius ×1.5.
• Death + Cold — frostbite drains more life.
• Life + Earth — roots hold the foe.
# Opposites
• Fire + Cold — Thermal Shock: the target turns brittle for 6 s (Earth hits it twice as hard), and a burning or frozen target bursts.
• Life + Death — Rebirth: a foe killed within the next 3 s rises on your side for 20 s.

spell.magicka.explosion.desc:
Three spinning crimson magic circles stack above the aimed spot for 2 s, then a pillar of light strikes it. Everyone within 16 blocks:
• Damage 12 ❤ fire
• Heat 120
• Thrown far away
It blasts a crater 14 blocks in radius (up to 3000 blocks) and leaves a mushroom cloud.
The price: for 8 s you cannot cast any element, get Slowness IV and Weakness II.
spell.magicka.explosion.self: The blast goes off at your feet and throws you high into the air with slow falling for 8 s; you take no damage from it. The price is the same.

spell.magicka.fire_titan.desc:
A giant fire titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either hurls fireballs that explode within 2.5 blocks: damage 5 ❤ fire, heat 120;
or slams the ground with both fists, which sets the ground on fire; everyone within 5 blocks takes 4 ❤ fire and heat 150.

• Heat 40
• Stone skin (resistance II), 15 s
